label: Firmware
description: Operate a constrained Linux VM via a shell API: find the password for cooler.bin, fix its settings.ini, run the binary, and extract the ECCS-... code.

steps.label: Explore VM filesystem
steps.detail: Discover available shell commands and explore /opt/firmware/cooler/ and the system for the password

steps.label: Fix settings.ini
steps.detail: Identify misconfiguration in settings.ini and patch it using the VM's non-standard edit command

steps.label: Run cooler.bin
steps.detail: Execute /opt/firmware/cooler/cooler.bin with the correct password/parameters to get the ECCS code

steps.label: Submit code
steps.detail: Send the ECCS-... confirmation code to /verify
